title: Three Months and One Short Page
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：novel　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 novel 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1992 the writer ① wrote the novel that no reader in the study would have counted, and he said the writing was the whole of the month. The ② novel, meaning the book itself and not the page, ran three months and stayed uncounted in the book; a novel, he said, is the only thing in a study that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ novel in that study had the same short page beside it, and the ④ novel at the far shelf, meaning the draft they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A novel, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the writer said the counting is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the novel was the whole of the matter, meaning the story and not the book. The ⑥ novel, meaning the story and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; novel, he said, is either something you write or the only word that means both a book and a story. He said the story is the part they remember.

By 1997 the ⑦ novel had become a line in a manuscript, and the manuscript had become an argument about the short page. The ⑧ novel of the whole thing, the writer wrote in January, was one study and three months of counting; novel, he said, is either the draft at the far shelf or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ novel I remember is the book counted in the manuscript, which closed in 1999 and is still counted as the quietest in the study. A ⑩ novel, my mother said in 2001, is the only book that improves by being counted; every novel, she said, is a story that has agreed to look like a book. She said the story was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 小说（指书斋里每一部旁边的那一部）
B. n. 小说（指那部小说本身，与薄薄的书页相对）
C. 固定搭配：write the novel 写这一部小说
D. n. 小说（指留给孩子们誊的那一份）
E. n. 小说之事（抽象总称，指一处书斋的小说之事）
F. n. 小说（指手稿里写到、被清点的那一部）
G. n. 小说、世事（指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 世事（抽象总称，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: wrote the novel that no reader in the study would have counted
The novel, meaning the book itself and not the page
the novel at the far shelf
the novel was the whole of the matter
the novel had become a line in a manuscript
The novel of the whole thing
A novel, my mother said in 2001

answers.why: write the novel 意为“写这一部小说”，1992 年那位写作者把书斋里没有一位读者肯清点的一部小说做了一遍。
novel 意为“小说”，指那部小说本身而不是薄薄的书页，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被清点。
novel 意为“小说”，指书斋里每一部旁边的那一部，每一部旁边都有同一页薄薄的书页。
novel 意为“小说”，指最远那层书架的留给孩子们誊的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
novel 意为“小说、世事”，指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这部世事就是那件事的全部。
novel 意为“世事”，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西而不是那部小说，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
novel 意为“小说”，指手稿里写到、被清点的那一部，到 1997 年这一部成了手稿里的一行。
novel 意为“小说之事”，写作者一月写道，整件事的小说之事是一处书斋和三个月份的清点。
novel 意为“小说”，我记得的是手稿里清点过的那一部，1999 年写就了，至今仍被说成书斋里最安静的一部。
novel 为抽象总称，母亲 2001 年说，小说是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的小说。
